newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lukoil, Agip to exploit Siberian field.
newsitem.headline: Lukoil, Agip to exploit Siberian field.

text.p: Russia's biggest oil company NK LUKoil and Italy's Agip SpA have signed a letter of intent on joint exploitation of the North Pokachev oilfield in Siberia, LUKoil said on Thursday.
Investment in the project, in which LUKoil will have a 60 percent share and Agip 40 percent, will exceed $220 million, LUKoil said in a statement.
The North Pokachev field is in the Nizhnevartovsk district of Tyumen region, LUKoil said.
It has recoverable reserves of more than 30 million tonnes, and will produce 1.39 million tonnes a year nine years after the start of the project.
The exploitation will be handled by LUKoil and Agip's LUKagip NV venture, which was set up last year, LUKoil said.
LUKAgip is already working in fields in Azerbaijan, Malaysia and Egypt.
